root_cause: One-shot generation with no execution feedback: literal/case mismatches, wrong filter columns and NULL-unsafe NOT IN silently return 0 rows
what: Adds an execute-and-repair loop: the draft SQL is run via env.execute, and if it errors or returns zero rows the harness feeds back the error/empty result plus a diagnostic checklist (case-insensitive LIKE for string literals, verify the column actually holds the value, TRIM trailing spaces, NULL-safe NOT EXISTS instead of NOT IN) and asks for one corrected query using the second allowed policy call. Also strengthens the system prompt with these general SQLite rules so the first draft is more often right.

root_cause: Repair loop only triggers on execution errors/zero rows/literal mismatches, so semantically wrong but executable drafts (too-narrow projection for entity questions; hallucinated column names) are never repaired
what: Add static pre-execution diagnostics to solve.py: validate every table/alias-qualified and bare identifier against parsed CREATE-statement columns (catching invented column names like student_id/friend_id), and flag narrow projections (single name-like column or DISTINCT of one column) when the question asks 'which/show/list <entities>' without naming attributes; feed these notes into the existing single repair call. Strengthen system_prompt.md with explicit rules to use only declared column names (inspect actual relation columns instead of guessing) and to return full rows (including joined rows) for entity-level questions.

root_cause: Repair loop only reacts to errors/zero rows/literal mismatches, so executable-but-semantically-wrong drafts (invented column names that silently resolve elsewhere, too-narrow projection) are never re-examined
what: Adds schema-grounded static diagnostics before execution: every table/alias-qualified and bare identifier in the draft is checked against columns parsed from CREATE statements, and unknown ones trigger a repair note listing the real columns of the referenced tables (fixes sp0894's invented Friend.student_id/friend_id which made NOT IN return nothing). Also adds a narrow projection-scope check for entity-level 'which/show the X' questions over joins that select only one name-like column, telling the model to return full rows of the main entity table (fixes sp0755). Both reuse the existing single repair call; no new policy calls.
